mapper.sql: r.id, r.doctor_id, d.real_name AS doctor_name, r.department_id, dp.name AS department_name, r.target_schedule_id, r.request_type, r.schedule_date, r.period, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.total_count, r.fee, r.remark, r.status, r.requested_by_user_id, r.reviewed_by_user_id, u.username AS reviewer_name, r.reviewed_at, r.review_remark, r.applied_schedule_id, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM doctor_schedule_request r JOIN doctor d ON d.id = r.doctor_id JOIN department dp ON dp.id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.reviewed_by_user_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM doctor_schedule_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedule_request SET status = 3, review_remark = '医生取消申请' WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE doctor_schedule_request SET status = 1, reviewed_by_user_id = #{operatorUserId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, applied_schedule_id = #{scheduleId} WHERE id = #{id}
